# Section 040: Continuous Delivery With Flux

Flux is the second GitOps controller the exam allows. This compact section teaches the Flux objects that match the Argo CD skills the reader already has, so they can pick either tool on exam day. It comes after Argo CD because it reuses the same repositories and packaging and only changes the controller.

**Curriculum item covered:** Implementing GitOps Workflows for Application and Infrastructure Deployment

---

## What You Will Master

- Install the Flux controllers and check them with flux check
- Create a GitRepository source and a Flux Kustomization that applies a path with prune enabled
- Read the Ready condition of sources and Kustomizations with flux get and kubectl describe
- Force a reconcile and suspend and resume a Kustomization
- Order two Kustomizations with dependsOn
- Create an OCIRepository or HelmRepository source and a HelmRelease with inline values
- Read HelmRelease status and history and find why an install or upgrade failed
- Configure install and upgrade remediation so a failed upgrade rolls back
- Load values from a ConfigMap with valuesFrom
- Match each Flux object to the Argo CD object that does the same job

---

## The Learning Path

The section has the modules below, in reading order. Each module has a playground for practice.

### 1. Reconcile Git Sources With Flux Kustomizations
*   **Module Reader:** Reconcile Git Sources With Flux Kustomizations
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-01/playground` — kind cluster with the flux CLI 2.9.6 and the Flux controllers installed (no bootstrap), and Gitea with repository `starfleet/scout-deploy` (Kustomize base and overlays) and a read-only credential Secret ready in `flux-system`. Deliberately absent: no GitRepository or Kustomization; no Argo CD in this cluster.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-01/playground
    ```

### 2. Deliver Helm Releases With Flux
*   **Module Reader:** Deliver Helm Releases With Flux
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-02/playground` — kind cluster with the Flux controllers, outbound internet to ghcr.io, and a HelmRelease `scout` in `starfleet` (podinfo chart) that is deliberately failing: its values set a readiness probe path that never answers, so the upgrade times out. No remediation is configured yet.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-02/playground
    ```

### 3. Automate Image Updates With Flux
*   **Module Reader:** Automate Image Updates With Flux
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-03/playground` — kind cluster with Flux 2.9.6 plus the image reflector and image automation controllers, Gitea with `starfleet/scout-deploy`, an in-cluster registry holding `scout` tags 6.14.0 and 6.15.0, and a read-write Git credential Secret. Deliberately absent: no ImageRepository, ImagePolicy or ImageUpdateAutomation.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-03/playground
    ```
